package.name: rmw_perf_pingpong
package.description: RTT-based rmw-layer performance measurement tool (rmw_tickle/COMPARISON.MD's own "Design: rmw_perf_pingpong" section) - replaces buildfarm_perf_tests for trustworthy latency numbers, same-host or cross-host: a pinging side computes round-trip time entirely against its own clock reading, never comparing a timestamp read on a different machine, so it needs no cross-host clock agreement (NTP-synchronized or not) at all - unlike the retracted item 5 one-way-delay attempt this replaces. Portable across every RMW_IMPLEMENTATION (rmw_tickle, rmw_fastrtps_cpp, rmw_cyclonedds_cpp), same binary, same message, same QoS.
